ideas.title: Healthcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent $150K fine imposed on a health insurance company in Minnesota for being charged in a fraud scheme.
ideas.angle: Exploring the implications of the fine and potential widespread issues within the healthcare industry
questions: What are the details of the fraud scheme?
How common is healthcare fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover more instances of healthcare fraud in Minnesota and the impact on policyholders.

ideas.title: Election Fraud Investigations
ideas.description: Investigate ongoing election fraud investigations, including the FBI's investigation into 2020 election fraud conspiracy in Georgia.
ideas.angle: Examining the potential impact on election integrity
questions: What are the details of the 2020 election fraud conspiracy?
How widespread is election fraud in the US?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the ongoing efforts to ensure election integrity and the challenges faced by investigators.
